AUDIT-7 Lane 4 batch 3 progress — 61 valid PRs audited, 4 invalid payload references (2026-11-25)

This slice processed #7734, #7737, #7738, #7739 and #7744. Outcomes:

- #7734 → #787: `audit:partial`. Slice C landed; later #12926 and #13267 deliver D/E/F, but #787 still lacks the real-terminal supported/unsupported smoke evidence. Closure correction pointer: #13871 comment 7157311605; evidence link on PR #7734 comment 7157315412.
- #7737 → #7736: `audit:complete` (roadmap-annotation surrogate-safe cap).
- #7738 → #5892: `audit:complete` (per-interface DoS catalogue).
- #7739 → #5803: `audit:complete` (foreign-store adapter contract).
- #7744 → #7741: `audit:complete` (three diagnostic text caps and regression tests).

The PR bodies, diffs, comments, source issue/comment captures, later PR evidence, closure timeline, verdicts and label readbacks are in [the continuation ledger](https://github.com/developing-today/code/blob/audit7-batch3-five-20261125/doc/20261125_merged-pr-audit_audit7-batch3-prs-7734-7744/20261125_merged-pr-audit_audit7-batch3-prs-7734-7744.md), on the existing docs PR #14847.

Cumulative count: 61 valid PRs audited from 65 payload entries; four payload identifiers (#7667, #7668, #7693, #7694) are issues rather than PRs; 185 identifiers remain, next #7745. Earlier count corrections are recorded in comments 7156848591 and 7156775726.
